The structure of DyHf(CoO2)2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Dy each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Hf centers have eight O neighbors, and O centers have five geometric neighbors (one Co, one Dy, three Hf). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Co- and Dy-centered 6-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between these and Hf-centered 8-vertex polyhedra.
